name: Athlete's Bible
title: Father’s Heart Bible — Athlete's Bible
sub: For Christian Athletes, Football Players, Basketball Players, Pickleball Players, Soccer Players, and Baseball Players

hook.h2: You know what it is to train when no one is watching. Your Father is watching, and He delights in you
hook.text: The angel of our Father returned a second time, touched him, and said, “Get up and eat—the journey is too much for you.”
hook.note: Elijah ran ahead of Ahab’s chariot all the way to Jezreel. A day later he lay exhausted under a broom tree and wanted to quit. Our Father did not push him harder. He sent bread and water, let him sleep, and sent it again. Win or lose, your Father’s delight in you was settled before the game began.

short350: For every athlete, from the weekend runner to the pro. The player, the coach on the sideline, the parent in the stands: the Athlete's Bible from Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) is the Holy Bible made for you.

Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color™ is a complete Bible, Old and New Testaments, in a fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek that reveals God as your Father. It is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's words in RED, the Spirit's words in PURPLE.
It equips you to receive the Father, hear His voice, and know His heart is for you.

For Christian athletes, coaches and athletic trainers, team chaplains, and the parents of athletes. For football, basketball, pickleball, soccer, baseball and softball, volleyball, tennis, golf, running, cycling, swimming and every sport in between. For marathons, triathlons, college athletics, youth leagues and senior night.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page.

An athlete lives by the scoreboard. Our Father spoke to a leader facing his hardest season, and He speaks it still: "Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not fear or be discouraged, for I, your Father, am with you wherever you go." He is not waiting on a win, a roster spot, or a record before He speaks.
An interpretive translation with a stated theological emphasis: the revelation of God as Father. Not a paraphrase — every word is rendered from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: He Has Been Speaking The Whole Time
body: For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

long.h: Before The Game And After It, He Is With You
body: An athlete lives by the scoreboard. Our Father spoke to a leader facing his hardest season, and He speaks it still: "Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not fear or be discouraged, for I, your Father, am with you wherever you go." He is not waiting on a win, a roster spot, or a record before He speaks. Your identity rests on His voice, not the result.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal. This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: Abba Father, your Heavenly Father, and you, His beloved son or daughter. If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Athlete's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — with a cover and opening pages made for an athlete. Those pages include a dedication, Where to Turn, “A Prayer for Athletes”, “Game-Day Prayers”, and a presentation page for their name. Everything from Genesis 1:1 onward is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is the Athlete's Bible a complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,085 verses, 890 pages, full color throughout. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note and short prayer closes each one, and 1,355 study notes run through the whole Bible.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for athletes?
faq.a: It is made for it. A 6 x 9 Bible in hardcover or paperback with a presentation page for their name, in a cover made for athletes rather than a generic pew edition.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
